technicalBlocker: The relevant local portal requires authentication; the anonymous login page's inspected JavaScript/configuration exposed only a Leaflet ArcGIS World_Dark_Gray_Base basemap and no parcel API/schema. queries.result: Arabic-language discovery located the official Sharqia governorate Spatial Variables Unit login portal and Egyptian General Authority for Survey Arabic map pages. The Sharqia portal is authentication-gated; no anonymous parcel schema or geometry endpoint was exposed.

requests.assessment: Official Arabic Egypt map page returned HTML and links to a general Egypt map; no parcel API/configuration was present. This is general national mapping evidence, not city parcel coverage.
Official map catalogue returned HTML linking Arabic/English downloadable country and regional PDFs; no parcel query service or schema was exposed.
Official district/map page returned an image map and ordinary site scripts only; no parcel service endpoint was exposed.

Sharqia governorate Spatial Variables Unit login wall returned successfully. Anonymous HTML/JS showed Leaflet and a public ArcGIS World_Dark_Gray_Base basemap only; no parcel layer, ID field, geometry schema or anonymous query route was disclosed. Credentials and cookies were not retained.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No anonymous parcel geometry and safe native ID were verified; login-gated local coverage and national general maps are insufficient for adapter qualification.
